changed.name: Changing Pad Cover Jersey - Teddy Bear

fields.label: Περιγραφή
fields.before:
A cute jersey cover with a print of teddy bears that fits perfectly around your changing mat is the most practical basic in your layette. The fabric is soft and stretchy. Thanks to the elastic around the edge, the cover will stay properly in place around the cushion. And with this fun Teddy Bear print, it will also look cute and beautiful. Without a cover, the changing mat is pretty cold, and the plastic is not very comfortable. A loose towel will slip off, and it won't cover the edges. A standard hydrophilic cloth is too small and too thin to cover the changing mat properly. This changing mat cover will stay firmly in place, like a fitted sheet. You can easily wash it, and it will make your baby (and you) feel comfortable. Doesn't that sound great? We recommend buying multiple covers. There will always be at least one cover in the laundry. Changing mat covers have a lot to deal with. Like “Oops… the milk is running down my cheeks onto the cover” or “Ah.. I'll start peeing now that my diaper is off”. You can count on it… you will have to change the changing mat cover at least once a day, and sometimes even multiple times a day.

Teddy Bear collection

Combine the cute Teddy Bear print on this cover with other items from the Teddy Bear collection. The Teddy Bear print can also be combined with the Pure Knit and Stargaze themes.

Colour

This cool all-over Teddy Bear print has an Ivory background, and the Teddy Bears are available in Biscuit and Nougat.

Size

With a size of 50x70 cm, this cover will fit our Jollein changing mat, and other changing mats with a standard size.

Material

100% jersey cotton. There is elastic at the edges, just like with a fitted sheet. So it'll always stay in place!

Washing

You can wash this cover up to 60 degrees. You will find further washing instructions on the washing label.
fields.after:
This Jersey changing pad cover with trendy Farm print is the finishing touch of your baby room. A changing pad cover protects your changing pad and is nice and soft for your baby. After small accidents it is easy to clean the changing pad cover by washing it on a high temperature. Besides using it as a changing pad cover, you can also use it as a fitted sheet for the cradle of pram. Because of the rubber band it always fits well. Which print is your favourite?

Great changing pad cover of jersey cotton with Teddy Bear print by Jollein. Did you see the other items from the Teddy Bear collection yet? The changing pad cover is made of 100% jersey cotton and is available in size 50x70 cm.

You can wash this item at a maximum temperature of 60 degrees, it is suitable for the tumble dryer and can be ironed. Always read the wash label for further instructions.

fields.label: Περιγραφή
fields.before:
Your little one will spend a lot of time on a changing mat. And how perfect is this lovely cotton knitted changing mat cover? The beautiful knit makes the cover look luxurious. What's more, this cover is 100% GOTS! You can easily close the cover with press-studs, so that it will stay in place around the changing mat, without shifting. You'll notice that you can never have too many changing mat covers. You'll be changing the changing mat cover at least once a day, and usually even multiple times a day.

Shell Knit collection

Our latest knit! The lovely knitted pattern provides a luxurious look, and it's comfortably warm and soft. The Shell Knit collection is available in the colours: Wild Rose, Sea Foam and Nougat. This collection offers blankets for the cradle and cot and changing mat covers. Furthermore, all items are GOTS certified! This means that you can take extra good care of your little one. You can perfectly combine the Shell Knit collection with items from the Rosehip collection or the Farm collection.

Colour

Available in three colours: Wild Rose, Sea Foam and Nougat.

Material

The changing mat cover is made of 100% cotton (GOTS).

Size

With a size of 50x70 cm, this cover will fit perfectly around the Jollein changing mat, and all changing mats of a standard size.

Washing

You can wash the cover at 30 degrees. Lay it down flat to dry. For more instructions, check the washing label.
